item.title: I Asked AI to Help Me Read My Great-Grandfather's Homework. It Failed Spectacularly.
item.description: A 100-year-old Cantonese children's book exposed surprising blind spots in our most advanced AI systems. Sometimes the best stress tests come from the most unexpected places.
